widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the character design reference sheet showing the front, back, and side views of the character.
<Subject 1> is the anime-style girl from <Picture 1>, featuring long wavy pink hair, pointed pink fox ears with a white floral-feather hairpin, light-blue eyes, a white strapless sweetheart bodice with a heart cutout, a dark purple corset skirt with white ruffles and hanging ribbons, detached navy puff sleeves, dark mid-calf boots, and a large fluffy pink fox tail with a white tip.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video portrays <Subject 1> performing a fluid and energetic traditional-fusion dance upon an ancient ornate wooden stage illuminated by warm silk lanterns, amidst falling cherry blossom petals.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the character's anime facial structure, pink hair, fox ears, complete dark purple and white costume, accessories, and fluffy pink fox tail from <Picture 1> are faithfully retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is rendered in a high-end 2D anime style with vibrant cinematic lighting, atmospheric fog, and fluid character animation.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot opens on an ancient oriental courtyard stage framed by red lacquered wooden pillars, carved balustrades, glowing orange silk lanterns, and a mist-covered dark wooden floor where pink cherry blossom petals drift through the air. In the center of the stage, <Subject 1> begins a graceful dance sequence. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at a steady speed and arcs slightly to the right as she executes a smooth, sweeping pirouette; her long wavy pink hair, detached puff sleeves, and large fluffy fox tail trail fluidly behind her rotation. She steps lightly on the balls of her purple boots, swaying her hips and extending both arms outward in an elegant arching gesture, causing the gold-trimmed purple overskirt and dangling ribbons to billow outward.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a dynamic medium close-up from a slightly low angle. <Subject 1> finishes a quick spin and lands on one foot with a lively hop. Her face radiates energy with a bright open-mouth smile, her blue eyes catching the warm lantern glow. She extends her right hand forward in a playful idol-style gesture while placing her left hand gracefully on her hip, her ears twitching slightly and her large pink-and-white tail curling smoothly to frame her silhouette as petals drift past the lens.

overall_soundscape:
The rhythmic, crisp tapping of boots on hollow wooden floorboards blends with the soft swishing of fabric and trailing ribbons, accompanied by the subtle rustle of a gentle breeze blowing through blossoms.

non_diegetic_music:
An energetic traditional-fusion musical track featuring fast-paced plucked guzheng and pipa melodies blended with upbeat electronic synth drums, light flute runs, and a bright, crescendoing finale.
